summary: Comprehensive testing of 5 Engagement Features: Loyalty Points, User In-App Notifications, Reviews/Testimonials, Wheel of Fortune, and Exit Intent Popup. Backend: 22/22 tests passed. Frontend: All components verified and working correctly.

issues: Minor accessibility warning: DialogContent missing DialogTitle for screen readers (console warning only, not user-facing)

GET_loyalty_my.description: Returns points, total_earned, redeemable_value, tier (name, color, bonus_multiplier), points_per_pound, redeem_rate. Requires auth.

POST_loyalty_redeem.description: Redeems points for wallet credit. Validates: auth required, sufficient points, multiple of 100. Returns credited amount and remaining points.

FRONTEND_LOYALTY_TAB.description: Dashboard Loyalty tab renders with: tier display (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Diamond), points count, redeemable value, 'How it works' section, tier progression chart, active discounts list.

GET_notifications_my.description: Returns notifications array and unread_count. Requires auth. Notifications have: notification_id, type, title, message, read, created_at.

POST_notifications_read_all.description: Marks all user notifications as read. Returns success:true. Verified unread_count becomes 0 after call.

FRONTEND_NOTIFICATION_BELL.description: UserNotificationBell component in navbar: shows bell icon, unread badge when count > 0, dropdown with notification list, mark all read button, proper icons per notification type.

GET_reviews.description: Public endpoint returning approved reviews only. Each review has: review_id, username, rating, text, approved=true.

GET_reviews_pending.description: Admin-only endpoint returning pending (unapproved) reviews. Currently 0 pending reviews.

POST_reviews_approve.description: Admin-only endpoint to approve a review. Requires admin auth.

FRONTEND_REVIEWS_SECTION.description: HomePage has reviews section (renders when approved reviews exist). AdminPage has 'Recenzii' tab showing pending reviews for approval.

GET_wheel_prizes.description: Public endpoint returning 8 prizes: 10% Reducere, 15% Reducere, 25% Reducere, £1 Credit, £2 Credit, 50 Puncte, Mai incearca!, £5 Credit. Does NOT expose probability.

GET_wheel_status.description: Returns can_spin (boolean) and previous_spin (if already spun). Requires auth. Admin user can_spin=false (already spun).

POST_wheel_spin.description: One-time spin per user. Returns prize_id, prize_label, prize_type, prize_value, prize_color. Second spin returns 400 error.

FRONTEND_WHEEL_MODAL.description: WheelOfFortune modal: opens from Loyalty tab CTA, shows 8-segment wheel with Canvas API, displays previous spin result (£1 Credit), spin button correctly disabled with 'Ai folosit deja roata' text.

POST_exit_intent_claim.description: Claims 15% discount valid 24h. One-time per user. Returns success, discount_percent=15, expires_at. Second claim returns 400.

GET_discounts_my.description: Returns active (unused, not expired) discounts. Each has: discount_id, percent, expires_at, source, used=false.

FRONTEND_EXIT_POPUP.description: ExitIntentPopup component in App.js: triggers after 10s delay when mouse leaves viewport top, shows 15% discount offer, claim button, 24h validity notice.

critical_code_review_comments: All 5 engagement features are fully implemented and working correctly
Loyalty tier system has proper multipliers: Bronze 1x, Silver 1.2x, Gold 1.5x, Diamond 2x
Wheel of Fortune correctly enforces one-spin-per-user limit
Exit intent discount correctly enforces one-claim-per-user limit
Notifications are properly created when wheel prizes or discounts are awarded
All endpoints have proper authentication checks
Frontend components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
